cta.title: Jinja Templates From SQL
cta.description: Install MiniJinja to render templates with JSON context — for HTML, configs, notifications, and dynamic SQL generation.

quickStart.title: Render a message from JSON context
quickStart.description: The template inserts a name and loops through a short list. This example produces plain text.
quickStart.note: Use HTML autoescaping when rendering HTML. Disabling it here is appropriate for plain text; rendered SQL is still text until you explicitly execute it.

entryPage.title: MiniJinja: Render Templates in DuckDB SQL
entryPage.seoDescription: Render Jinja-style templates from DuckDB SQL with MiniJinja. Pass JSON context to generate text, HTML, configuration, or SQL strings.

introduction.title: Turn query results into formatted text
paragraphs: MiniJinja is a template engine using Jinja-style expressions, conditions, loops, and filters. This extension combines a template with JSON context inside DuckDB and returns the rendered text as a string.

Use it to generate a message, configuration fragment, or HTML snippet from each query row. Your SQL supplies the values and the template controls their presentation. Choose escaping appropriate to the output: HTML needs different treatment from plain text.
